offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures pressure energy recovery devices and high-pressure pumps that cut the energy used in seawater reverse osmosis desalination. Sold mainly to desalination plant owners and engineering contractors, who install the equipment in their plants.

primary_products.value: pressure exchanger energy recovery devices; high-pressure pumps; replacement parts

primary_services.value: aftermarket maintenance and service; technical support for desalination plants

customer_segment.value: B2B: desalination plant owners, engineering and construction contractors, water system integrators; B2G: municipal and government-owned water utilities

end_markets.value: water desalination; industrial process water; wastewater treatment

revenue_model.value: product sales: energy recovery devices and high-pressure pumps sold to plant builders and owners; service fees: aftermarket service, maintenance, and replacement parts for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds energy recovery devices and pumps, sold to desalination plant builders and owners; service provider: maintains installed equipment for plant operators under service contracts

geography_served.value: global: Installed base across Middle East, Asia, Americas, Europe, and Australia desalination plants

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on pressure energy recovery devices and related high-pressure pumps for desalination

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling directly to plant owners and large engineering contractors; partners / resellers: system integrators and pump partners that include the equipment in packaged plants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pressure equipment safety standards and water quality and environmental rules that apply to desalination plants

notes: Product and revenue mix may have shifted in recent years, so the description reflects my best knowledge.
